gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-libertinus-serif: Comic Relief draws every stroke at a constant width, with bowls left open on one side. Libertinus Serif settles in below with a slight swell on its curves, so a long read feels authoritative and unhurried.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-libre-caslon-text: Libre Caslon Text lifts the pen mid-curve, leaving its loops unfinished. Its light thick-thin modulation against the heading's uniform, marker-like line is what makes the pair work.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-lustria: Traditional in spirit, Lustria lets its weight shift gently and opens a wide mouth in the lowercase a, while the heading stays fixed. One is built to announce, the other to settle in.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-maitree: Maitree has a dignified serif manner, its curves open and its strokes swelling gently from hairline to stem. Comic Relief is best at blunt, single-width shouting, and Maitree at tame, steady contrast that never goes razor thin.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-marcellus: Comic Relief makes its crossbars as heavy as its stems. Marcellus, a serif with subtle etched-in-glass modulation, would look timid if the heading shrank or lost its weight, and heavy if the body were enlarged.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-martel: A marker-nib line that ignores direction defines Comic Relief, with bowls left unfinished on one side. And Martel, a serif of moderate contrast, adds lightly shaded texture, which is the strongest thing the two share.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-mate: Mate reads as editorial and dignified, with cupped round letters and a soft step from heavy to light strokes. Comic Relief, with its crossbar and stem sharing one width, makes a blunt opener for it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-mate-sc: Comic Relief holds a steady, unvarying line with bowls left unfinished. Its best trick is bold, flat-weight punch, while Mate SC's best is the faint nib-pressure shading of a classic serif.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Refined and editorial, Nanum Myeongjo lets curve tips stop short of touching. Comic Relief is best at flat, unmodulated punch, while Nanum Myeongjo does its best work in a calm ebb and flow of thickness.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-noto-serif-hk: Noto Serif HK reads as dignified and editorial, with a generous gap where each curve ends and crossbars slightly thinner than stems. But Comic Relief keeps its line weight unvarying, so a long page moves from loud to quietly shaded.
